definitions.explanation: Making continuous, reliable progress toward a goal. Implies methodical advancement without rushing.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}は{着々|ちゃくちゃく}と{進|すす}んでいる。
{準備|じゅんび}が{着々|ちゃくちゃく}と{進|すす}む。
{着々|ちゃくちゃく}と{実績|じっせき}を{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねてきた。
examples.english: They have steadily built up their track record.

notes:
PATTERN: {着々|ちゃくちゃく}と + verb (usually {進|すす}む)

NUANCE: Implies reliable, methodical progress - neither too fast nor too slow. Often used positively to describe projects or preparations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{着々|ちゃくちゃく}と{進|すす}む (to progress steadily)
・{着々|ちゃくちゃく}と{準備|じゅんび}する (to prepare steadily)
・{着々|ちゃくちゃく}と{力|ちから}をつける (to steadily gain strength)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{徐々|じょじょ}に (gradually - slower pace)
・{順調|じゅんちょう}に (smoothly - emphasizes no problems)
・{確実|かくじつ}に (certainly, reliably)
